Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up for the UK finalization window next week (Jun 7-11). Forms auto-lock Fri 16:00 BST. We have 5 unclaimed reviewer bundles and one manager out sick — need delegation guidance.

Ben Carter: I can pick up 1 evening bundle (BST). How do I claim it?

Nora (People Ops): Add to the UK swap sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/UK-swaps. Columns: Name | Bundles | Times | Delegate? Y/N. Also add `DELEGATE-REQ` if manager sign-off is missing.

Leila Hassan: Manager sign-off missing for team ENG-ML (MGR-410). If delegate used, what goes in the form?

Nora (People Ops): Use `DELEGATED_APPROVER` field with approver name + email. We need director email confirmation for delegation. Template (paste into email):

`Subject: Delegated approval for <Manager> <dates>`
`Body: Approver: <Name> (<email>) confirms delegation.`

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Delegation docs & exception flow: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/delegation. Forms lock in 72 hours.

Marco Silva: I'll claim 2 bundles and can be the delegated approver if director confirms.

Nora (People Ops): Thanks Marco — noted. Operational CSV (systems ingestion):

`reviewer, email, bundles, timezone, flags`
`Marco Silva, marco@redwood.ai,2,BST,DELEGATE-CAN`

People Ops Bot: Event: "UK calibration check - final week" Tue 09:30 BST. RSVP auto-populated from swap sheet.

Nora (People Ops): Final ask — if you take overflow, please add `ANON-QA` if you want inclusion in anonymized calibration sample. Will post final roster 24h before lock.
